question: I've got some cash and I'm nervous. Are the markets looking toppy right now, and are there any big-name stocks that already broke below their support / moving averages that I should stay away from?

tools_called.result_summary: US macro economy as of 2026-08: Real GDP growth 1.484% (falling, 23rd percentile — near the low end of 10yr history, slowdown signal). Industrial production 1.079% (rising, 62nd pct). CPI inflation 3.304% (rising, 71st pct — elevated). Core PCE 3.344% (rising, 74th pct — elevated). Unemployment 4.1% (falling, 55th pct — still healthy). Nonfarm payrolls -23k (falling, 7th pct — very weak, near 10yr lows). Fed funds 3.63% (falling, 65th pct — cutting cycle). Read: slowing growth + elevated inflation + weak payrolls = stagflationary pressure. Markets have macro reason for caution; toppy conditions supported by data.

60 large-cap stocks (capped) trading below BOTH their 50-day and 200-day moving averages (broken below key support).
